div.div:
How a version scales
Each WorkerResourceTemplate (order-fulfillment-scaler, checkout-abandon-scaler) is rendered by the controller into one KEDA ScaledObject per running build, so a ramping and a current build scale independently. KEDA's temporal trigger asks the frontend for that build's backlog every 15 s and sets replicas to ceil(backlog / 5) between 1 and 3; the floor of 1 keeps a draining build serving its pinned workflows. A drained build is scaled down after 1 h and deleted immediately after (deleteDelay 0 s).

div.div:
Out of this picture
checkout-abandon writes only its own checkout database and calls no service. Both workers and the server export telemetry: worker SDK metrics go OTLP to the collector and on to vmagent; the server's four ServiceMonitors are scraped by vmagent. Workflow IDs, retries and the saga steps are in docs/api/temporal.md.
